about.title: Systems-minded builder from Oman
about.intro: I'm a final-year Software Engineering student at Al Buraimi University College with a 3.96/4.00 CGPA, more interested in shipping working systems than collecting frameworks. My capstone, StudyNest, took me from a problem statement to a deployed, AI-powered platform used by real students — and to the national STEM finals.
about.focus: I focus on full-stack development, low-latency real-time applications, and practical AI integration. I like work that is precise, fast, and accountable to real users.
